card.statement:
Let $p\in\KK[h]$ with $\degg p=1$, $C \in \KK$, $\lambda \in \Roots_{u+C}$ and $X \subseteq \Roots_{u+C}\setminus\{\lambda\}$ a submultiset. Then

\[
\E(p,C,\lambda,X)^\vee\simeq A_C(X\cup\pb{\lambda}, \alpha^{-1}),\quad \text{where $\alpha=p'(t)\in\KK^{\times}$.}
\]

In particular, $A_C(\Roots_{u+C}, \alpha^{-1})\simeq\E(p,C,\lambda,\Roots_{u+C}\setminus\pb{\lambda})^\vee$.
card.label: Lemma 12

paper.title: Representations of Smith algebras which are free over the Cartan subalgebra
paper.abstract: In this paper, we study the category of modules over the Smith algebra which are free of finite rank over the unital polynomial subalgebra generated by the Cartan element $h$ and obtain families of such simple modules of arbitrary rank. In the case of rank one we obtain a full description of the isomorphism classes, a simplicity criterion, and an algorithm to produce all composition series. We show that all such modules have finite length and describe the composition factors and their multiplicity.
